plain: A separate network trained to break a model's internal activity into many simpler features that people can label.
eli5: Sorting a big jumbled box of crayons into many small, labelled piles.
technical: An autoencoder trained to reconstruct a model's activations as a sparse combination of many learned features, used to undo superposition; the features can be labelled and used for steering, though labels can mislead (the Pain Axis authors found labelled "pain" features that did not track pain).
